title: Audio evidence
responsibility: Presents a recording with playback, transcript, provenance and download controls.

inputs.name: AudioEvidence.item
inputs.description: Required audio evidence including file, title, status and optional duration, transcript, source, note and provenance. Missing flag, empty file or playback error yields unavailable/not-proven display. Valid recorded duration takes precedence over loaded metadata.

inputs.name: AudioEvidence.assetBase
inputs.description: Required prefix concatenated directly with the recorded file to form playback/download URL.

inputs.name: AudioEvidence.idPrefix
inputs.description: Optional HTML ID prefix, default evidence-. Additional copies can supply a distinct prefix to avoid duplicate card IDs.

outputs.name: AudioEvidence
outputs.description: Audio card with user-initiated controls and no preload. Playing pauses other document audio; destruction pauses its player. Missing audio exposes notes. Transcript disclosure starts open when text exists. Shows provenance/time and a sanitized download filename with phase and recognized extension. Playback metadata fills missing duration but does not change recorded status.
